admin.title: Payment gateways & methods
admin.lead: How clinics pay their subscriptions and reps pay plans and ads to the platform: card through PayTabs, bank transfer (IBAN), CliQ or an e-wallet.

admin.card_on_help: Needs the profile ID and server key from the PayTabs dashboard.
admin.key_help: PayTabs: Developers → Key management → Server key. Stored encrypted.
admin.urls_note: No addresses to set in PayTabs — the platform sends them with each payment:
admin.bank_lead: Shown on platform invoices and payment pages.
admin.wallet_lead: Such as Zain Cash, Orange Money or any other wallet.
admin.wallet_on: Show the wallet as a payment method
admin.moved: Bank transfer, CliQ, wallet and card payment details are now on the “Payment gateways” page.
